trigger: Kael requested that the previously supplied prompts for passive/semi-passive income, opportunity discovery, digital assets, content monetization, business automation, diversified portfolio, BI, 36-month planning, daily planning, strategic reasoning, research, learning, decisions, problem solving and editing be researched and integrated only where profitable and beneficial to Nexia.
research_conclusions: Do not optimize for the label passive income; optimize for sustainable after-tax profit, repeatability and low verified human attention relative to economic value.
Recurring revenue improves predictability only when continuing customer value exists; MRR/ARR/churn/LTV/CAC are model-conditional metrics and must not be forced onto one-time businesses.
Digital products can reduce inventory and replication cost but still require demand, distribution, differentiation, support/update and legal/platform analysis.
Content/audience is first treated as a distribution asset; reach/followers are not business outcomes until connected to leads, buyers, settled revenue and contribution.
Reliable automation should be measured, observable and retain human approval for sensitive external effects until the exact path is authorized and verified.
Broad idea generation is discovery only; WIP remains one primary monetization experiment plus maximum two material research veins.

project_instruction_decision.reason: Project Compact V3 already contains the required invariants and is 7791 characters against the 7800-character safe generation ceiling. Duplicating the long prompts into the UI layer would increase fragility and violate anti-duplication/size discipline.
project_instruction_decision.routing: Detailed behavior lives in repository operating modules and automations; Project instructions remain invariant-focused.

truth_limit: This event proves research integration, repository persistence and automation-prompt readback only. It does not prove demand, sale, payment, profit, content audience, recurring revenue, external-user digital-product success or persistent 24x7 autonomy.
